fact: On 18 December 2025 the Ministry of Health's Integrated Health Projects Administration Unit issued a request for expressions of interest (MoH/IHPAU/SRHR/CQS/01/2025, closing 15 January 2026) for a firm to customise, deploy and maintain a bespoke OpenMRS electronic medical record across hub and spoke facilities, stating that donor financing will support the initial phase of EMR deployment across 300 health facilities, 250 PHUs and 50 hospitals.
title: Hiring Of A Consulting Firm To Develop/Customize, Deploy, Manage And Maintain an Electronic Medical Records System
publisher: Ministry of Health, Integrated Health Projects Administration Unit (IHPAU)
